capabilities.name: Managed integrations
capabilities.summary: Connect trusted services and browser clients through one managed product surface.
limitations: Access is issued by an administrator; public signup is not part of this preview.

capabilities.name: Webhook delivery
capabilities.summary: Receive or send signed HTTP events with delivery status and retry behavior.
limitations: Provider-specific inbound signature adapters remain separate integrations.

capabilities.name: Durable work
capabilities.summary: Accept work for later processing when a receiver may be busy or offline.
limitations: Delivery is at least once; application effects must be idempotent.

capabilities.name: Live updates
capabilities.summary: Keep connected screens informed with low-latency application updates.
limitations: Live updates are for connected clients; use durable work for required processing.

capabilities.name: Legacy v2 compatibility
capabilities.summary: Keep an existing v2 integration working while planning a move to v1.
limitations: Use v1 for new integrations; legacy compatibility is maintained only where documented.

capabilities.name: Collaborative rooms
capabilities.summary: Planned shared-room primitives for collaborative product experiences.
limitations: Do not use this capability in production examples until its release evidence exists.
